focused_follow_up_prompts.title: Okamura permission and dictionary gate
focused_follow_up_prompts.prompt: Read-only public-source research only. For Okamura and Yamada, https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0229132 and Figshare https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/11538792 (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.11538792.v1, file 20725707), inspect public paper and metadata only, at most 3 documents and 256KiB per metadata response. Establish whether explicit consent/deidentification documentation permits a bounded adult task-only workbook inspection. Current review acquired no workbook; CC BY4.0 does not settle privacy/schema permission. Do not fetch the XLSX. Return a proposed minimum dictionary/header-only scope or a clear hold.
